title: Dream Manipulation
text: “W-well?”
Rafumi smirked, cool and nihilistic.

“I told you already, didn’t I? I didn’t come here to get in your way. Gaelion’s only doing her duty as the guardian of love—beyond that, she deals with things as the whim takes her. Basically, she’s on your side.”
“Then why cooperate with this?”

“It’s not as though holding some weakness of yours over your head would gain me anything, is it? So rather than that, better to erase the evidence and just make it look like he was dreaming… because that sounds more entertaining.”

What an endlessly whimsical creature it was, I say. In any case, if it was willing to help, I saw no reason not to make use of it. Rafumi even employed illusion magic to secure us a place to move him. And so it was that Rival and I hauled Rabbit Guy into his bed. Rafumi then pressed a hand to the sleeping Rabbit Guy’s forehead and worked its illusion upon him.
“Ngh!? Nnngh… nnnh…”
Rabbit Guy let out a somewhat pained-sounding mumble in his sleep, but eventually settled into silence.
“With this, whether he was merely half-asleep or not will remain conveniently ambiguous.”
Somewhere in the back of my mind, I felt as though Father were saying something about how absurdly lax the security in this caravan was, but surely that was just my imagination.
“Don’t get caught next time, hm? If you’re going to blow your cover, do it properly—make a grand, exhilarating scene of it. That is, if you insist on turning into a riska just to go play around.”
“Quiet, it. This is none of your business, I say.”
“Regardless, wouldn’t it be wise to change back quickly? Shield Hero already suspects us quite a bit. He keeps glancing this way now and then, riska.”

Grr… infuriating as it was, it seemed prudent to end the fun there and change back. Father did not suspect me in the slightest. And so, having finished treating Itsuki’s tail, we all went our separate ways for the night.
The next morning.
“Naofumi-san!”

Itsuki came dashing over to Father, who was busy preparing breakfast. A little earlier, as always, Ren’s scream had echoed through the tent. This morning, it seemed he’d been sleeping wrapped up in Luna-chan’s feathers rather than Keel’s.
“Morning, Itsuki. Sleep well last night?”
“Never mind that! Look at this!”
Itsuki thrust his freshly regrown tail toward Father as if to say just that.
“What’s wrong, Itsuki?”
At this, Ren also poked his face out from where he was buried in Luna-chan’s feathers.
“What’s wrong is—why on earth are you dressed like that!”
“Don’t ask! You already know why!”
“Ah… looks hot in there.”
“Quiet. Anyway…”
Ren seemed to have finally noticed Itsuki’s tail as well.
“Did it regrow like a lizard’s tail or something?”
“How should I know! Do squirrels even do that?”
“Tails are pretty easy to lose, so you have to be careful with them, but I’ve never heard of one growing back… though, well, this is another world, I suppose.”
Father, dispensing his trivia as usual.
“Nothing like this has ever happened before—what on earth is going on?”
“Even I can’t say for sure. Kou was pretty worried about it too. Um, we should probably report this to Emia-san and Rishia-san, right?”
“I went to sleep separately from those two, and then suddenly this happens—what am I even supposed to make of it…”
“Gah! Luna! Let go already! Wyndia! Gaelion!”
As Ren shouted, Assistant and Rival—her mother currently inhabiting the young one’s body—came running at the commotion.
“Luna-chan. Let go of Ren-chan, he doesn’t like it.”
“Wyndia! Don’t you dare add ‘-chan’ to my name!”
“Gya, gyaw!”
Rival’s mother let out a rather weak intimidating growl. Her strengthening still wasn’t sufficient, it seemed, so she couldn’t quite gauge her own power yet.
“Kawa’s tail is all pretty now—so cute—”
“Wah! Are you planning to stuff even me into those feathers! I won’t allow it!”

I stepped in between Itsuki, who was bracing himself against Luna-chan, to stop things before they escalated. I would not allow it, I say. Itsuki really has gotten quick with his hands lately, it seemed.
“Boo… but he’s so cute though—”
“Let—go—of—me! Damn it! Keel! Where’s Keel!”
“Keel went off to sleep at Lars-chan’s village with Raphtalia-chan and the others last night.”
“Luna! You go bother Keel instead! Why is it always me?”
“Ehh… Keel-kun was with Luna the day before yesterday, so Luna just came to see Ama, since he’s been going out a lot lately—”
Whenever Keel wasn’t taking part in the Melromarc performances, she’d sometimes go stay in Panda’s village. On nights like that, they slept apart, apparently.
“Ren-san’s problem is a daily occurrence at this point, so please deal with it later.”
“Don’t deal with it later! Gah… let go of me—!”
While Luna-chan, Assistant, and Rival’s mother carried on with their exchange off to the side, Itsuki pressed Father to solve the mystery of his tail.
“Naofumi-san. Do you have any idea what might have happened?”
Father glanced my way for just a moment before quickly looking away again.
“Hmm… actually, don’t you have any clues yourself, Itsuki? Like, was it itchy right before it healed, or something?”
“Not particularly… I remember lying down to sleep last night, but after that…”
Well, of course—he’d been sleeping like a log. Utterly defenseless. After all, he’d been foolish enough not to notice me approaching even in my riska form, I say.
“U-um… fwaaaaaaah…”
Just then Rabbit Guy came shuffling over, yawning sluggishly.
“Ah, Teo. Morning. You slept in quite a bit today.”
“Next thing I knew, it was already this late, and yet I’m still sleepy somehow… fwaaaah…”
“Did you stay up late or something?”
“That shouldn’t have been the case… or so I’d like to think, but for some reason I can’t quite remember when I fell asleep…”
“Are you a child?”
“Oh, quiet. That’s my business, isn’t it? Or is it a crime to sleep now?”
The two of them glared at each other.
“You two sound so alike it’s like you’re bound to butt heads or something?”
“We are nothing alike. I’ve thrown away something as worthless as justice.”
“That’s the punishment for all that arrogance you had before.”
“That’s exactly the kind of thing old Itsuki would’ve said, isn’t it, Teo?”
Rabbit Guy and Itsuki both groaned, apparently with nothing to say in their own defense.
“That’s all in the past. I only do what I believe in now—and I already think justice is a worthless notion.”
“So then, your tail looks like it’s regrown—did something happen?”
“How should I know. I woke up this morning and it was already like this.”
“Some special ability of this ‘riska’ thing, perhaps?”
“If it had an ability like that, wouldn’t it have regrown right away?”
“Fair point…”
Rabbit Guy tilted his head repeatedly, studying Itsuki.
“What’s wrong?”

“No… I’m not sure if it was a dream or what, but I recall having a dream where I heard some kind of voice coming from Kawasumi-san’s sleeping area, and went to check on it. And then somehow Iwatani-sama turned into a woman—”
“Wait, Teo? What exactly are you talking about? There’s a time and place for describing dream contents, you know?”

Rabbit Guy seemed to snap back to himself with a start, clapping a hand over his mouth. Just what sort of dreams was this Rabbit Guy having!? Father, turning into a woman? Even after I’d jabbed him with a Sleep Lance, for him to be having such a blasphemous dream—what an outrageous scoundrel, I say. Or so I thought, but then I remembered Rafumi had been casting illusions on Rabbit Guy. In other words, this was Rafumi’s dream manipulation at work!
“Frankly, I couldn’t care less what your dream was about, so please don’t bother.”
“Morning, Vof…”
And just then, Wolf arrived, having finished his morning training with Crocodile Guy. There were far too many people around, I say.
“Vof, tail grew back.”
“Please don’t all show up in waves like this. I’m not explaining it. Just infer it yourselves.”
Wolf sniffed curiously at Itsuki’s regrown tail.
“Vof? Smells a little burnt.”

A side effect of Fireheal, perhaps? Maybe the scent came from having lightly singed Itsuki’s skin. My own scent, of course, would be all over the surrounding air already, so there was no way anyone could pick it out specifically.
